scripts.enrich:content: npm run enrich:definitions && npm run enrich:examples
scripts.prepare:web: npm run copy:web && npm run copy:fonts
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync:android && npx cap run android
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync:ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run cap:sync:ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run cap:sync:ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -scheme App -configuration Debug
